svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Foreign platforms blocked in mainland China and the Chinese firms that hold those markets
svg.desc: Diagram in two halves divided by a wall labeled Great Firewall, with each firm shown by its logo. Left, blocked in mainland China: Google, blocked fully in 2014; Facebook, blocked in 2009; Twitter, blocked in 2009; YouTube, blocked in 2009. Right, the Chinese firm that holds each market: Baidu for search, WeChat for social networking, Weibo for microblogs, Douyin for video.
